alexcrichton opened PR #14539 from alexcrichton:try-fix-spurious to bytecodealliance:main:

The previous dup2 fix seemed to probably work for just a TCP inheritance, but with Unix now in play as well the test didn't handle this situation well enough and we're still getting [spurious failures][spurious]. This is an attempt to fix that.

[spurious]: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/actions/runs/37324908307/job/111813946004
